headline: HP Beats Q4 Revenue Estimates but Stock Falls on Cautious 2027 Outlook
summary: HP Inc beat fourth-quarter revenue expectations but saw its shares decline due to a cautious profit outlook for fiscal year 2027.
why: HP is a major manufacturer of personal computers and printing hardware, making its corporate outlook a proxy for enterprise IT spending.

impacts.name: HP Inc
impacts.why: Cautious future earnings guidance depressed investor sentiment despite a quarterly beat.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: HP's stock slipped after the company issued a conservative earnings forecast for fiscal year 2027.
